move.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
We value our cooperation and we understand the cost pressure on your side; we want an agreement that keeps our partnership healthy for both of us.

We confirm a binding volume of 6000 units a year for the 24-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Our bottom-up should-cost estimate for this part is on file (cost:part:SH-220).
We have reviewed your delivery performance in our supplier scorecard (sc:DEMO-C1@2026Q3).

On this basis we propose: EUR 12.55 per unit, payment 60 days net, lead time 42 days, delivery EXW, for our full demand of 6000 units a year over 24 months.

What would you need from us to move further on the price? We are open to discussing any term that helps you.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear partner,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We highly value the confirmed volume of 6000 units and acknowledge your feedback regarding our delivery performance.

As you mentioned flexibility on terms to help with price, we request keeping payment at 45 days to support our working capital. With this adjustment, we are pleased to offer a revised price of EUR 15.20 per unit for the 42-day lead time.

Our current offer stands at a price of €15.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days, delivery EXW. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €15.20 per unit. A price of €15.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days, delivery EXW is also available. Our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
